signature.name: VTask.prod
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {A : Type u_2} -> {B : Type u_3} -> {C : Type u_4} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [Semiring A] -> [Algebra R A] -> [Star A] -> [Semiring B] -> [Algebra R B] -> [Star B] -> [Semiring C] -> [Algebra R C] -> [Star C] -> (f : A →⋆ₐ[R] B) -> (g : A →⋆ₐ[R] C) -> A →⋆ₐ[R] B × C

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total on all pairs of star algebra homomorphisms with the same domain and scalar ring; no junk-value or boundary conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {R A B C : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Star A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B] [Star B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R C] [Star C] (f : A →⋆ₐ[R] B) (g : A →⋆ₐ[R] C) (a b : A), VTask.prod f g (a * b) = VTask.prod f g a * VTask.prod f g b

facts.statement: ∀ {R A B C : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Star A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B] [Star B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R C] [Star C] (f : A →⋆ₐ[R] B) (g : A →⋆ₐ[R] C) (a b : A), VTask.prod f g (a + b) = VTask.prod f g a + VTask.prod f g b

facts.statement: ∀ {R A B C : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Star A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B] [Star B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R C] [Star C] (f : A →⋆ₐ[R] B) (g : A →⋆ₐ[R] C), VTask.prod f g 1 = 1

facts.statement: ∀ (R A B C : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Star A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B] [Star B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R C] [Star C] (f1 f2 : A →⋆ₐ[R] B) (g : A →⋆ₐ[R] C), f1 ≠ f2 → VTask.prod f1 g ≠ VTask.prod f2 g
